articles.title: Roche Secures FDA Approval for Wilserdly in Advanced Breast Cancer Treatment
articles.summary: Roche Holding (USOTC:RHHBY) has received approval from the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for Wilserdly (giredestrant), an oral treatment for certain forms of advanced or metastatic breast cancer. The Swiss pharmaceutical company announced on Monday that the drug had been authorised for use in combination with Afinitor, a treatment marketed by Novartis (SIX:NOVN).
